verdict.rationale: Docs clearly support routing rules like order/only/sort, per-provider timeouts, automatic failover on error, and default dynamic provider selection based on latency/uptime — this covers availability and cost-based switching mid-task. However, there's no explicit evidence of policy-driven switching based on 'capability' (e.g., routing to a more capable model for harder subtasks) or agent-initiated dynamic policy changes mid-task beyond static config; routing rules appear configured per-request/providerOptions rather than dynamically decided by the agent's own logic mid-task. missing for 10: explicit capability-based routing policy, evidence of agent dynamically changing routing mid-task (not just static failover/order config), independent/hands-on validation of routing rules working as described.
